prompts.name: capture
prompts.summary: Saves each message to today's daily note, files it and says where it went.

prompts.name: review_daily_notes
prompts.summary: Reviews each unreviewed daily note: files blocks, links topics, marks the day reviewed.

tools.name: add_excerpt
tools.summary: Files blocks of a daily note into a topic note as an excerpt.

tools.name: add_footer_topic
tools.summary: Adds a topic note chip to a note's Note footer.

tools.name: add_link
tools.summary: Adds a wikilink from one note to another, as a reference or a named kind.

tools.name: add_to_canvas
tools.summary: Places a note on a canvas at a position.

tools.name: add_to_smart_folder
tools.summary: Puts a topic note in a Smart Folder.

tools.name: append_to_daily_note
tools.summary: Adds text verbatim to the end of a daily note, creating the day if needed.

tools.name: create_canvas
tools.summary: Creates a new, empty canvas with a unique title.

tools.name: create_note
tools.summary: Creates a new note, tagged agent-authored and inbox for you to review.

tools.name: create_smart_folder
tools.summary: Creates a Smart Folder at the top level or inside another folder.

tools.name: delete_canvas
tools.summary: Deletes a canvas; the notes on it are untouched.

tools.name: delete_smart_folder
tools.summary: Deletes a Smart Folder; its subfolders move up and no note is deleted.

tools.name: get_canvas
tools.summary: Reads a canvas with its placed notes, their positions and the links between them.

tools.name: get_daily_note_changes
tools.summary: Shows the blocks added, changed or removed in a daily note since its last review.

tools.name: get_day_filing
tools.summary: Shows which topic notes hold each block of a daily note, and which blocks are unfiled.

tools.name: get_note
tools.summary: Reads one note in full, optionally with its outgoing links and backlinks.

tools.name: get_vault_guide
tools.summary: Reads the Vault Guide, the framework and decisions the agent files by.

tools.name: get_vault_settings
tools.summary: Reads the vault settings agents work within, such as folder depth and link kinds.

tools.name: list_canvases
tools.summary: Lists every canvas, most recently updated first.

tools.name: list_open_feedback
tools.summary: Lists your open comments and corrections on the agent's filing, oldest first.

tools.name: list_smart_folders
tools.summary: Lists every Smart Folder with its topic notes, plus the notes in no folder.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.summary: Lists the tags you have written in notes, with how many notes carry each.

tools.name: list_unreviewed_days
tools.summary: Lists the daily notes still waiting for a review, oldest first.

tools.name: mark_day_reviewed
tools.summary: Marks a daily note reviewed and records what the review changed.

tools.name: move_node
tools.summary: Moves a note to a new position on its canvas.

tools.name: neighbors
tools.summary: Lists the notes linked to a note, up to a few hops away in either direction.

tools.name: record_feedback
tools.summary: Saves feedback you gave in chat about the filing, already marked handled.

tools.name: remove_excerpt
tools.summary: Takes one excerpt of a day back out of a topic note.

tools.name: remove_excerpt_block
tools.summary: Takes a single block of a day out of a topic note, splitting the excerpt around it.

tools.name: remove_from_canvas
tools.summary: Takes a note off a canvas; the note itself is untouched.

tools.name: remove_from_smart_folder
tools.summary: Takes a topic note out of a Smart Folder.

tools.name: resolve_feedback
tools.summary: Marks one piece of open feedback handled, with a one-line reply.

tools.name: search
tools.summary: Finds notes by keyword or meaning and returns the best-matching passages.

tools.name: tag_note
tools.summary: Applies one of your tags to a note and adds it to the Note footer.

tools.name: untag_note
tools.summary: Removes a tag an agent applied to a note, along with its Note footer line.

tools.name: update_link
tools.summary: Changes the kind or label of an existing wikilink.

tools.name: update_smart_folder
tools.summary: Renames a Smart Folder or moves it to a new parent.

tools.name: update_vault_guide
tools.summary: Rewrites the Vault Guide and notes what changed.
